title: "Homework 2 - Sanitized Coursework Copy"
output: html_document

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r library, message=F, warning=F}
library(tidyverse)
```

### 0. 
define data for simulate 

```{r}
set.seed(12345)
y <- matrix(rbinom(10000 * 1000, 1, 0.1), 10000, 1000)
x <- matrix(rnorm(10000 * 1000), 10000, 1000)
x[y==1] <- rnorm(sum(y==1), mean=2)
```



### 1. 

0)Set critical values for each test

```{r}
alpha <- 0.05
t20 <- qt(1-alpha/2, df=20)
t50 <- qt(1-alpha/2, df=50)
z <- qnorm(1-alpha/2)
```

1)find the significant genes

```{r}
t20_sig <- abs(x) > t20
t50_sig <- abs(x) > t50
z_sig   <- abs(x) > z
```

2)compute the proportion of significant genes

```{r}
t20_sig_rate <- colMeans(t20_sig) 
t50_sig_rate <- t50_sig %>% colMeans()
z_sig_rate   <- z_sig %>% colMeans()
```

3)report the averaged proportion of the significant genes over 1,000 replications for each test.

```{r}
data.frame(
  Test = c("T20", "T50", "Z"),
  Average_proportion = c(mean(t20_sig_rate), mean(t50_sig_rate), mean(z_sig_rate))
)
```

### 2.

```{r}
alphas <- c(0.01, 0.05, 0.1)
t20_s <-list()
t50_s <- list()
z_s <- list()

for (a in alphas) {
  sig <- as.character(a)
  t20_s[[sig]] <- qt(1 - a/2, df = 20)
  t50_s[[sig]] <- qt(1 - a/2, df = 50)
  z_s[[sig]]   <- qnorm(1 - a/2)
}

H0_t <- y == 0
fpr_results <- list()

for (a in alphas) {
  sig <- as.character(a)
  
  sig_t20 <- abs(x) > t20_s[[sig]]
  sig_t50 <- abs(x) > t50_s[[sig]]
  sig_z <- abs(x) > z_s[[sig]]

  fpr_t20 <- rowSums(sig_t20 & H0_t) / rowSums(H0_t)
  fpr_t50 <- rowSums(sig_t50 & H0_t) / rowSums(H0_t)
  fpr_z   <- rowSums(sig_z   & H0_t) / rowSums(H0_t)
  
  fpr_results[[sig]] <- c(
    T20 = mean(fpr_t20, na.rm = TRUE),
    T50 = mean(fpr_t50, na.rm = TRUE),
    Z   = mean(fpr_z,   na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

fpr_results %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>%  
  rename_with(~ paste0("α = ", sub("^X", "", .x))) %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "Test")
```

### 3.

```{r}
H0_f <- y == 1

tpr_results <- list()

for (a in alphas) {
  sig <- as.character(a)
  
  sig_t20 <- abs(x) > t20_s[[sig]]
  sig_t50 <- abs(x) > t50_s[[sig]]
  sig_z <- abs(x) > z_s[[sig]]

  tpr_t20 <- rowSums(sig_t20 & H0_f) / rowSums(H0_f)
  tpr_t50 <- rowSums(sig_t50 & H0_f) / rowSums(H0_f)
  tpr_z   <- rowSums(sig_z   & H0_f) / rowSums(H0_f)
  
  tpr_results[[sig]] <- c(
    T20 = mean(tpr_t20, na.rm = TRUE),
    T50 = mean(tpr_t50, na.rm = TRUE),
    Z   = mean(tpr_z,   na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

tpr_results %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>%  
  rename_with(~ paste0("α = ", sub("^X", "", .x))) %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "Test")
```

### 4. 

1)compute Bonferroni adjusted p-values

```{r}
bonf_alphas <- alphas / 10000
bonf_t20_s <- list()
bonf_t50_s <- list()
bonf_z_s   <- list()

for (i in 1:3) {
  name <- as.character(alphas[i])
  bonf_t20_s[[name]] <- qt(1 - bonf_alphas[i]/2, df = 20)
  bonf_t50_s[[name]] <- qt(1 - bonf_alphas[i]/2, df = 50)
  bonf_z_s[[name]]   <- qnorm(1 - bonf_alphas[i]/2)
}
```

2)see if there is at least one type I error (false positive, FP) among the significant genes for each test and each level.

```{r}
t1e_sum <- list()

for (a in alphas) {
  sig <- as.character(a)
  
  sig_t20 <- abs(x) > bonf_t20_s[[sig]]
  sig_t50 <- abs(x) > bonf_t50_s[[sig]]
  sig_z <- abs(x) > bonf_z_s[[sig]]

  t1e_t20 <- colSums(sig_t20 & H0_t) != 0
  t1e_t50 <- colSums(sig_t50 & H0_t) != 0
  t1e_z   <- colSums(sig_z   & H0_t) != 0
  
  t1e_sum[[sig]] <- c(
    T20 = sum(t1e_t20),
    T50 = sum(t1e_t50),
    Z   = sum(t1e_z)
  )
}

sum(unlist(t1e_sum))
```

3)report the proportion of replications with at least one FP among 1,000 replications for each test and each level.

```{r}
t1e_rate <- list()

for (a in alphas) {
  sig <- as.character(a)
  
  sig_t20 <- abs(x) > bonf_t20_s[[sig]]
  sig_t50 <- abs(x) > bonf_t50_s[[sig]]
  sig_z <- abs(x) > bonf_z_s[[sig]]

  t1e_t20 <- colSums(sig_t20 & H0_t) != 0
  t1e_t50 <- colSums(sig_t50 & H0_t) != 0
  t1e_z   <- colSums(sig_z   & H0_t) != 0
  
  t1e_rate[[sig]] <- c(
    T20 = sum(t1e_t20)/1000,
    T50 = sum(t1e_t50)/1000,
    Z   = sum(t1e_z)/1000
  )
}

t1e_rate %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rename_with(~ paste0("α = ", sub("^X", "", .x))) %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "Test")
```

### 5. 

1)compute adjusted p-values using the BH method with five different FDR levels of 0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 0.2 and 0.3.

```{r}
pval_t20 <- 2 * (1 - pt(abs(x), df=20))
pval_t50 <- 2 * (1 - pt(abs(x), df=50))
pval_z <- 2 *  (1 - pnorm(abs(x)))

adj_pval_t20 <- apply(pval_t20, 2,FUN = p.adjust, method = "BH")
adj_pval_t50 <- apply(pval_t50, 2,FUN = p.adjust, method = "BH")
adj_pval_z <- apply(pval_z, 2, FUN = p.adjust, method = "BH")
```

2)compute the false discovery rates (FDR) of three different tests and five different levels.

```{r}
fdr_lvl <- c(0.01,0.05,0.1,0.2,0.3)

fdr_list <- list()

for (i in fdr_lvl) {
  sig <- as.character(i)
  
  sig_t20 <- adj_pval_t20 < i 
  sig_t50 <- adj_pval_t50 < i
  sig_z <- adj_pval_z < i 
  
  
  fdr_list[[sig]] <- list(
   T20 = colSums(sig_t20&H0_t)/colSums(sig_t20),
   T50 = colSums(sig_t50&H0_t)/colSums(sig_t50),
   Z =  colSums(sig_z&H0_t)/colSums(sig_z)
  )
}

```

3)report the mean value of FDR over 1,000 replications for each test and each level.(exclude no rejections)

```{r}
fdr_result <- list()
for (i in fdr_lvl) {
  sig <- as.character(i)
  
  t20_fdr <- fdr_list[[sig]]$T20
  t50_fdr <- fdr_list[[sig]]$T50
  z_fdr   <- fdr_list[[sig]]$Z
  
  fdr_result[[sig]] <- c(
    T20 = mean(t20_fdr, na.rm = TRUE),
    T50 = mean(t50_fdr, na.rm = TRUE),
    Z   = mean(z_fdr, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

fdr_result %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rename_with(~ paste0("α = ", sub("^X", "", .x))) %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "Test")
  
```
